pipeline: imagegen -> Tencent -> constrained modular projection -> browser compression

parts.description: A square continuous blue-grey ravine cliff-face panel. Angular fractured natural rock strata and shallow crevices. No cave mouths, ledges, floor, arches, moss or boulders. Overall planar, straight square perimeter, shallow relief.

A rectangular walkable ravine ledge TOP SURFACE, dusty ochre-grey rock with fine gravel and small embedded pebbles. Exact overhead orthographic view, no vertical cliff face or raised obstacles. Mostly level and continuous, straight rectangle. No doorway, water, plants or loose boulders.

A rectangular vertical FRONT FACING EDGE of a rock ledge: broken layered blue-grey rock, a thin dusty ochre upper lip. Exact frontal elevation, no visible top surface. Straight overall perimeter and shallow relief. No entrances, plants or freestanding boulders.

One isolated broad NATURAL cave-mouth surround of craggy blue-grey rock with rough jambs and a low uneven stone brow. A clear round-topped arch opening reaches the bottom with no threshold. Opening and surrounding background are transparent. No tunnel interior, floor, glow or scenery. No masonry. Overall shallow front-facing surround, flat back, nearly rectangular outer mating envelope.

One isolated SMALL person-sized cave entrance surround in blue-grey cliff rock, narrow roughly pointed rocky brow and compact jambs. Transparent clear arch opening to the bottom, no threshold. Flat overall shallow surround, controlled straight outer mating edges. No floor, room interior, light or foliage. No carved masonry.

One isolated weathered pale-grey MASONRY garden arch surround, round voussoir crown and simple block jambs. Fully transparent arch opening to the bottom; no threshold. No vines or moss yet, no garden interior, leaf, door or furniture. Upright shallow front-facing frame with a flat back and controlled outer mating envelope.

One isolated ruined pale warm-grey MARBLE arcade bay: two simple worn stone piers and one round arch, restrained molding, broken weathered upper edge. Match the foreground marble ruin in the source. Transparent opening down to the bottom. No floor, adjacent arcade bays, cave wall, loose rubble, lighting or props. Shallow frontal architectural frame.

One square surface of worn pale-grey marble flagstones with fine cracks and small earthen seams, matching the foreground ruined hall. Exact overhead orthographic view. Flat continuous walking surface, shallow detail and straight square perimeter. No pillars, arches, walls, large rubble, plants or water.

ONE isolated chunky angular blue-grey ravine BOULDER, mildly asymmetrical, sharp weathered fractures and subtle earthy patches. A full small three-dimensional stone with a stable flat underside, front-biased orthographic three-quarter view with only modest side visibility. No ground, shadows, other rocks, plants, cliff, cave, water or props.

ONE isolated flat irregular patch of sparse green ravine MOSS and tiny clinging creeping leaves over a thin layer of blue-grey stone. Exact perpendicular front view; shallow relief, tiny grounded foliage only, no hanging vines or bushes. Square thin support surface with flat back, soft broken moss coverage within the square. No arch, doorway, floor scene, big rocks, water, flowers or fruit.

One square top-down orthographic patch of the shallow ravine RIVERBED: worn dark blue-grey stones, fine pebbles and gravel, darker damp cracks. No water or reflections; water will be a separate material. Mostly flat with only shallow embedded stones. Straight square perimeter. No banks, cliff walls, plants, arches or boulders.
